assumptions: Globigerina pachyderma (2009 bench-sheet obsolete name) was treated as Neogloboquadrina pachyderma, so it is counted in Neogloboquadrina rather than Globigerina.
Genus taken as the first word of each name; counts summed within genus; Bray-Curtis on raw counts, mean over all 45 sample pairs.
issues: species.txt was not in classic PAST format; I made species_past.txt with a '.' corner cell and underscores in place of spaces in taxon names so the toolkit could read it.
Dissimilarities show 2 material negative PCoA eigenvalues; this does not affect the mean dissimilarity.
summary: Aggregated 9 species columns to 5 genera (Globigerina, Globigerinoides, Neogloboquadrina, Globorotalia, Orbulina), merging the obsolete G. pachyderma into Neogloboquadrina. Ran the toolkit's Bray-Curtis community analysis on raw counts (study_out3) and averaged the 45 pairwise distances.
